exposure: slow release vaginal prostaglandin E2 insert
cohort: 600 multiparous women with a singleton pregnancy at or beyond 34 gestational weeks who underwent labor induction
finding: In multiparous women undergoing labor induction, the Bishop-score upon admission was not a good predictor for the success of labor induction or for maternal or neonatal adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: The Bishop-score upon admission did not affect the mode of delivery in multiparous women undergoing labor induction.
